description: Company standard for structured documentation directives.

idPrefixes.E: Explicitly specified by Eli; immutable without Eli's consent.
idPrefixes.A: AI-generated or AI-inferred guidance; revisable to align with E directives.

hierarchy.root: The first numeric segment identifies the document's root directive.
hierarchy.child: A child extends its parent's complete numeric path by one segment.
hierarchy.uniqueness: Numeric paths are globally unique regardless of E or A prefix.
hierarchy.topLevel: Top-level directives must be E directives.
hierarchy.ancestors: Every A directive must have an E ancestor. E directives may only have E ancestors. A directives may have E or A parents.

arrays.dos: Non-empty array of concise required actions.
arrays.directives: Optional non-empty array of child directives.
